propositions: Phase 2 removes 827 truncated bridge-echo comments lacking the reconciler marker across three Jira issues (REB-2605, REB-1931, REB-1567) that were skipped by Phase 1

Comments are identified as deletion candidates when they contain the truncation suffix and lack the reconciler marker, because marker is appended after body and gets cut off by 32767-character truncation
For each distinct normalized body, the oldest comment (lowest Jira id) is preserved as the keep-one survivor; all duplicates are deleted
After bridge re-enablement, a final sweep must invert the keep-one rule to preserve the comment id recorded in the bindings map, which points to the newest copy posted by the bridge
The backup payload reconciliation closes exactly (backup - deleted = observed) on all three issues, proving completeness despite not implementing the explicit len(fetched) == total assertion upfront
